text:
alex: Heads-up — spotted a gap in how per-route sampling and PII redaction interact when requests are routed to fallback models. We might leak small sensitive snippets in debug captures.

mira: Can you repro? is this during a canary or live traffic? :eyes:

alex: Live traffic. Happens when route A (high-sample debug) falls back to route B (lower redaction). Sampling decision is made pre-routing, redaction after routing, so fallback inherits the original sample tag.

devon: Oof. So we get high fidelity traces for requests that hit fallback but use B's redaction rules? That could miss PII guardrails.

raj: Quick proposal: attach a route-aware sampling flag that can be re-evaluated post-routing. If fallback route has stricter redact policy, override sample=true -> sample=maybe with a redaction-only capture.

sam: Agree in principle. Implementation-wise, that means changing the sampling api: `sampling.decide(req)` -> returns token plus `reevaluate_after_routing` bool. Then runtime can call `sampling.adjust_for(route)` after routing.

mira: Minimal UX ask for console: show both pre-route and post-route sampling rates on the request details page so SREs can see why a capture exists. Right now console just shows "sampled" which is confusing.

alex: Example config sketch: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: user-chat
    sample_rate: 0.001
    redact_level: standard
  - name: fallback-short
    sample_rate: 0.0001
    redact_level: strict
sampling:
  decision_point: pre-routing
  allow_post_override: true
```

devon: We also need telemetry metrics: `sampling.pre_rate`, `sampling.post_rate`, `redaction.override_count`, `redaction.skipped_due_to_quota`. Those will feed the dashboard.

raj: Important: quotas. If we let post-route increase sampling, that could blow budgets. We should make overrides subject to route quota checks and a per-tenant safety cap.

sam: Implementation detail: prefer to treat overrides as "redaction-only captures" — store metadata + hashed snippets rather than full payload when fallback triggers stricter policy, so cost stays low.

mira: On the console rollout path: add a small beta toggle "Route-aware sampling" behind feature flag. Rollout to 5 tenants, monitor `redaction.override_count` and `inspect.unredact_attempts`.

alex: Can we add an alert: if `redaction.override_count` / `sampling.post_rate` > 0.05 for 5m, page oncall? That indicates runaway fallbacks.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of sampling-adjust v2 to cluster-5 succeeded — id c7a9f.

devon: Nice. @mira can you add console mockups? Need a small callout that explains why some captured traces are redacted more aggressively after routing.

mira: On it. I'll drop screenshots in the ticket. Also proposing copy: "Sampling decisions may be adjusted after routing to honor route-specific redaction and quota policies."

raj: One more: rotate HMAC salt for pseudonymization annually, and track `pii.hash_rotation_version` on each sampled artifact so we can rehydrate if legal requests arrive.

sam: Note: legal/replay team asked that rehydration requires dual approval (owner + security) and we log the approver ids in the audit.

alex: Solid. Next steps: devon to PR sampling re-eval API, sam to spec storage format for redaction-only captures, mira to add console bits + dashboard metrics, raj to update quota checks and HMAC rotation plan.

mira: I'll create the UX ticket and add the mockups by EOD.

devon: I'll open a draft PR, assign to @sam and @raj for review.

raj: I'll update quota service to expose `can_override_capture(tenant, estimated_cost)` and a test harness.

sam: Will draft the data retention note: redaction-only captures kept 30 days by default, extendable with compliance contracts.

alex: Thanks all. Let's aim for small canary next week. :lock:

mira: +1

sam: +1

devon: +1

raj: +1
